The dish is a white plate that spans about 360 px in the image. If it is a roughly 26 cm dinner plate, that is about 14 px per cm. The greens, which look like sautéed collards or chard with a few carrot pieces, cover about 240 px, or roughly 17 cm, in width.

The pile looks fairly loose and about 2-3 cm tall. That suggests roughly 150-200 g of cooked greens. Cooked greens are low in energy, about 50-70 kcal per 100 g once oil is included. Sautéed greens with a little oil come to around 90 kcal per 100 g, so 170 g gives about 130 kcal.
